package.name: nova_calibration
package.description: NovaSM3 calibration routines. v1: servo zero-position (home) auto-detect via mechanical hard-stop probing using STS3215 load feedback. Results persist to ~/.nova/calibration/ as datestamped YAML; the gait layer loads the offsets to convert raw 0..4095 encoder counts to URDF joint radians. Sibling of nova_ops — not on the gait critical path.
